variable.description:
(Required) The unique deposit method identifier. 

Prefix is "dmt" in production and "sbx_dmt" in sandbox.

request.description:
Create and process a payin using a payin configuration and a deposit method. The merchant status must be ACTIVE to create a payin.

The deposit method details (i.e bank account number and billing contact) will be duplicated to a payment method and a payin will process against the newly created payment method. Metadata, method metadata, and new billing contact details can be defined on the [Payin Config](ref:create_payin_config).

This endpoint requires Rainforest approval.

request.description:
Create a deposit method. A deposit method is assigned to a merchant and is where the merchant's funds for their payment activity will be deposited to.

This endpoint requires Rainforest approval. Platforms that meet all [requirements](doc:send-sensitive-data-via-api#requirements) and are approved by Rainforest can send the full bank account numbers to Rainforest via a direct API integration.
